description:
Get server status

HTTP: GET /v1/server/status
Category: Server
Required scopes: server:read
Read-only.

_fields.description: Comma-separated item fields to keep, e.g. "id,domain_name,php_version" — trims large items to what you need.

_limit.description: Keep only the first N items of the returned list (applied by this MCP server, not the panel). Use on large lists.

_match.description: Keep only items whose JSON contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. a domain name or status.

name: panelica_server_get_v1_server_status
